g.text: per-interconnector flow and at-limit counts printed

cmd: just nemosis-fetch DISPATCHINTERCONNECTORRES "2025/09/01 00:00:00" "2025/09/08 00:00:00" "" EXPORTLIMIT,IMPORTLIMIT | pass: prints 'nemosis-fetch: DISPATCHINTERCONNECTORRES rows=<N> sha256=<prefix>'
cmd: just nem-interconnector | pass: prints a row per interconnector then 'PASS nem-interconnector: one consistent interval count per interconnector'
